activities_top.name: Otaru Canal
activities_top.hours: Open-air promenade; gas lamps lit in the evening

activities_top.name: Sakaimachi Street
activities_top.hours: Shops roughly daytime. Music Box Museum 9:00-18:00 (until 19:00 Fri-Sat in summer), no closing days. Bank of Japan Otaru museum 9:30-17:00 (from 10:00 Dec-Mar), closed Wednesdays (open if a national holiday) and Dec 29-Jan 5.

events.name: Otaru Snow Light Path
events.recurrence: yearly, early February (8 days, usually overlapping the Sapporo Snow Festival)

editions.note: Main venues lit 17:00-21:00: Canal, Temiyasen (old railway path), Otaru Art Base and Tenguyama (upper ropeway station)
